sn29.9:1.2: nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn29.9:1.3: Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā saṃsedajānam nāgānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjatīti || || 4-6
sn29.9:1.4: Idha bhikkhu ekacco kāyena dvayakārī hoti || So yeva peyyālo || || 7
sn29.9:1.5: Ayaṃ kho bhikkhu hetu ayam paccayo yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā saṃsedajānam nāgānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjatīti || || 1-3
